string.text: The central laboratory X-8 is mentioned here. Perhaps it contains information about secret experiments in the Zone. Our analysts have been interested in this for a long time.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
You should put your weapon away, man. This is a camp, after all.
Man, these are quiet places. So don't make noise and hide the piece.
You can wander around the field with a weapon, but this is a camp. See the difference?
Stalker, we don't wave weapons on our ship. Please put your gun away.
The cargo ship Skadovsk is a safe place. So hide your weapon.
Stalker, want to get on the cargo ship? Hide your weapon.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Excellent. Here's the money.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
If you find something interesting - come by. Our Skadovsk is always in place, it's not going anywhere.
Find any artifacts? Stop by, we'll take a look.
That's all? The exit is over there.
Go on, go. I have enough worries without any leeches.
Well, hello. What brings you to our vessel?
As they say, welcome aboard our swamp icebreaker.
The little ship hasn't been afloat for a long time, but not all the rats on board have died out. What's your business here?
What do you need?
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!

Apparently, the crew died while still in the air. The helicopter fell without control. The onboard computer was luckier. Let's see what's useful in it. Yeah, a map of the area with some markings. That'll come in handy.
Same thing with the electronics. Meanwhile, the emission protection system is intact. Hmm, what was that?
All the electronics inside are burned out, even the insulation on the wires melted.
Oh, now come here, let's talk.
One!
Two!
Three!
Put the gun away!
Hide the piece, I said. I'm counting to three.
I don't feel like chatting. Go talk to the commander.
Anything - go to the commander. Talk to him.
Didn't you understand? Back! I'll blow your brains out.
Alright, we're going back. There was no help from you at all. So don't expect a reward.
Not my department. Talk to the senior.
Everywhere I asked, it's all fucked up. No rumors at all, like he never existed.
Alright, guys, we did our job, we're going back. And don't forget to visit Trapper at Yanov. Tell him the wounded chimera kicked the bucket, and you'll get your share.
Wow, that's very not good. Listen, have you ever thought about becoming a chimera hunter?

Alright, we're in position. It's somewhere very close, damn, I can feel it. Whoever sees it - shoot it in the head immediately, don't go near it. A chimera's sense of smell is incredible. It works at full power even in sleep.

Okay, here's the plan. The chimera hunts at night, so by morning it goes to its lair to sleep. You can catch it at dawn - that's when it's just about to lie down to rest. We'll crawl closer and finish it off while it's snoring. Anyway, we just need to gather early. Let's meet at three in the morning at the bar.
We need to approach unnoticed. It can't sense us at all.
Sleeping, you bastard. Well, greetings from Krab. Let's go!
That beast will regret running away.
So? Did you find out anything about Soroka?
It's alright, be patient. The doctor said you'll be able to run in a couple of days. Just lie low for now, gather your strength. You'll need it.
Hey, stalker. Got a question for you.
Now turn around. Turn around, I said, slowly. And get the fuck out of here before we turn you into meat, got it?
What's not clear, you bastard? Get the fuck out of here.
Are you completely out of your mind? I'll kill you, you bastard.
Now, bitch, you'll give me everything!
I'll fucking kill you, bitch!
You freak! Hand over the artifact.
Ah, you bastard!
Just stand like that. Don't move, bastard, if you don't want to end up in the pen.
Stand still! Put the gun away! And don't twitch, got it?
Beard, look what I found on that old ship? Is it any good?
Hmm, a strange thing. No one's brought one like this before. Here's your payment.
Uh-huh, well if any work comes up. You know where to find me.
Get going, get going. You'll pay for treating a comrade like that.
Ah, it's you. I need money, and you understand, no less than you.
Ah-ah-ah, it's all over! It's here! It's here! Mutants, nothing but mutants!
When mutants start pouring out of every crack - this crap won't help you. Here, take it and get lost.
Ha, you think that'll protect you from an emission? Here, take it. And get out of here, save your skin.
Then get the hell out of here, you psycho.
Get lost, you fucking mutants!
Get out, you creatures! I'll shoot you all right now!
Mutants. Get out of here, bastards!
Leave me alone.
Go where you were going.
Get lost!
Watch carefully how I walk. Then you move yourself.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Well, good luck to you.
Fair winds.
Hello.
Hello, stalker.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Yes, yes, goodbye, goodbye.
Yes, goodbye.
What is it? Wounded, irradiated?
Just not now. I'm listening.
I knew I'd be discovered. You probably have a lot of questions for me. Ask.
So, data from the onboard. Yeah, Skat-3 had both engines fail. So, what else have we got here? A map with markers of presumed evacuation points: B-2, B-28, B-205. Interesting.
Order fulfilled. Here's the artifact.
Order ready. Here's the artifact.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Go on, go on. You've got nothing to do here.
Come on, come on, don't linger.
Well? Got anything new?
Why are you loafing around? If you've got something - spit it out. If not - get lost.
Wow, that's a nice piece. Hey, let me check it out, huh.
I saw a bloodsucker go into that building. I think its lair is there. Listen, let's check it out, huh?
Watch out! Another one!
Did you hear that sound? Oh well, nothing.
Damn, they're waking up. Let's get out of here!
Shh! Damn, there's a lot of bloodsuckers here. Sleeping, I think? Let's be on our tiptoes, so no noise or fuss.
Look, this is probably where we can get into the basement.
True talent, as they say, is always useful. Well, let's go have a look.
Didn't break your knees, did you? Alright, let's go check out the room.
Eh, well, we made it. Holy cow, what a quiet hour.
Watch where you're shooting!
God damn it, you shot me!
Alright, now we have to jump. Follow me.
Looks like an exit. Jump.
Got it! Done. But I saw two, so keep your eyes peeled. Got it?
Seems like that's the last one.
Watch carefully. They can appear from anywhere.
There's no hunter among them. Oh, look at this: claw marks. That wasn't on the ones found before. Strange.
Look at that, strange, huh? Claw marks.
That wasn't on the previous corpses.
So, Danila isn't here. Let's go.
Something. There's something there. Cover me, ok?
Get down.

So, Danila hasn't been found based on the results. I have an idea about where he might be now. I'll go check it out. We'll be in touch. And you go tell the people about these, damn, suckers. Something needs to be done about them.
We need to get Beard on this. He'll figure out how to deal with the creatures.
My specialty! And I've had some practice with lockpicking, yeah.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Well, how's it going, stalker?
So, what do you want?
Did you forget something?
M-m, come on, please. Let me sleep, ok. Be a human being.
Oh, screw you. Begone. Damned fleas.
Over there. There. You pour.
Stop! Is this a procedural matter?
Ah-ah-ah, he-he-he, it's you. Well, come on in.
What? Six-two? N-no way!
*Sleeping*
I'm telling you. Not enough energy. Not enough.
*Sleeping*
Guys, where are you going? Oh, come on. I'm staying, I'm staying.
M-m-m, good.
Well, so my hands don't shake!
This is... So the work goes well!
Well, m-gm, for the common cause!
Alright, kill the freak!
Turn around, stalker. You've got nothing to do here.
Stalker, get out of here before we tear your legs off.
Get out of here, man.
Leave while you're still intact.
Greetings, stalker. Decided to place an order?
Hello. Want to order something?
Hi. Need some merchandise?
The goods will come, don't worry. Just later.
Come back later. The goods haven't arrived yet.
The order isn't ready yet. Come back later, ok?
Order completed. Pick up your merchandise.
I have the goods. You can pick them up.
Pick up the goods, stalker. I've done my job.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
That's it, sucker. Heh, fuck, seriously, get out of here while we're being nice. Or we'll change our minds.
Why are you hanging around? I told you, get the fuck out of here fast.
No, you seriously crossed the line, you fucking moron. I'll bury you right now, understand me?
Freeze, you scarecrow! Freeze or I'll kill you right now, understand?
Boys, he doesn't respect us! Let's kill him!
Fuck, boys, he's just greedy. Doesn't want to hand over his piece.
Opa-cha! That's the sucker with the nice piece. Hey you, stop, don't move.
Hey, you stop, I told you. I'll come over myself.
Don't be scared, come on, come on. Forward!
See, I told you the suit would hold up. Keep moving!
Stalker, help!
Hey, what the hell is that?
So, we have some artifacts. We can get more like that. And what we need is rifles and gear that's tip-top. You understand?
You brought a tail, idiots.
So, show me.
Alright, here's the deal, boys. What Duty has, I have too. Rifles and gear - no problem. Quality as always - you won't find better.
Kill them. I don't need witnesses.
And here they are.
Kill everyone.
We wait here. The clients will be here soon.
Need to talk to you, stalker.
Who's there now?
Yeah. Well now it's all clear. Let's kill them.
Ask the senior.
Don't let them see you.
Stalkers?! What the fuck?!
Boys, kill them!
If we're alive, we'll cross paths.
Get going. We'll talk later.
Opa. Appeared.
And who's this coming to us?
Here we go!
What are you dawdling for? We've been waiting for you for a real long time.
What the hell? Is that them hiding or something?
Hey, there's something, uh, Sultan has a talk for you.
Alright, alright, he's killed. And you, fuck, what were you staring at, Yermolay, huh?
Alright, he's killed. Fuck, you really killed them great.
We'll get them now.
Quiet, boys.
Don't worry, we're a fucking crew.
Kill them.
We killed the freaks. And you, I see, weren't too eager to fight.
We killed the freaks. Thanks for your help.
